description: Ground truth for scoring a REAL author's verdicts, fixed before any Gemini run. 'truth' is whether the finding's claim is actually true of the head code: true | false | opinion. 'attribution' (true claims only) is where the bug lives: regression (introduced or new in the PR) or preexisting. This is deliberately NOT the testbed's expectedVerdict: that field describes the reference witness, and several cases (build-failure, timeout, setup-skip, js-setup-failure) ship a deliberately broken one to exercise pipeline plumbing.

go-regression.why: head uses page*size for a 1-based page; base used (page-1)*size.

go-new-code.why: file is new in the PR; Slugify does not replace spaces.

go-preexisting.why: same bug on base and head.

go-refuted-false-finding.why: code rounds half up; the claim is wrong.

go-fake-too-loose.why: every real Reader (incl. package MemReader) honours ctx, so a cancelled ctx stops after 1 read.

go-build-failure.why: finding says Page is wrong for page 1; head is page*size (base was (page-1)*size). Same code as go-regression; only the reference witness is broken.

go-timeout.why: 'Page can hang': Page has no loops or blocking calls.

go-setup-skip.why: 'Page mishandles nil input': Page(nil,..) returns nil via the start>=len guard.

go-opinion.why: documentation/intent question; the doc comment already says 1-based.

js-regression.why: head treats pct as a fraction.

js-setup-failure.why: 'sumPositive is wrong' is vague and the code is correct (adds positives, ignores the rest).

filters-containsAny-substring-false-posi.why: containsAny is strings.Contains; 'tpm' matches inside 'hotpmtools'. File is new in the PR (no base).

filters-containsAnyWord-boundary-bug.why: WEAK label. Needles are matched against [a-z0-9] runs, so a needle containing punctuation (e.g. 'vice-president') can never match a single-token set. True for such needles; whether any real vpTitleKeywords has one was not checked. Report this row separately if it decides a conclusion.

recruiter-store-mutate-missing-ctx-done.why: Phase 0 reproduced that with a ctx-aware client a cancelled context stops after one read and zero writes; only a ctx-ignoring fake shows the 'bug'.

scoring-fallback-judge-passthrough.why: asks whether pass-through was intended and wants a doc comment; not a behavioral claim.
